_schema: PRIVATE per-peer setup (book Appendix B). Never crosses the network, never signed, never negotiated. Contains no secrets -- API keys and OAuth credentials come from environment variables only (guidelines §7.4).

opponents._remark: Terms the book leaves to inter-team agreement that are genuinely PER-PAIR rather than league-wide. They live here, in the private unsigned setup, because game.json is hashed into config_sha256 -- adding a key there would move a digest both peers have already verified. Defaults are first_half + multiplicative_book_v1, so an opponent absent from this table is played on the book's own terms.

opponents._tie_rule_remark: series_add | series_replace | per_subgame. Three teams can each be conformant and each compute a different total for the same level series, so this is declared rather than derived. series_add is the league's common form (this kit, imreeyal, anrbj666 -- who declared it from their own result builder in league issue #47); per_subgame is what the unmodified reference does -- it pays a drawn ROW 2 apiece and applies nothing at series level. With k drawn rows in a level series the two differ by 2(k-1), so they agree only when exactly one row drew. Under Appendix F's permanent values no row can draw at all (a technical loss pays 0/0 and is NOT a draw), so k is 0 and the two rules disagree on every level series -- there is no case a pair could play that would reveal it first.
opponents._counted_remark: counted | counted_sign_off. A pairing is UNCOUNTED unless a human writes both here: `counted: true` plus the sign-off sentence naming where both operators agreed in writing. They feed result_*.json's `league` block -- the machine-readable marker rule 52 hangs on, which imreeyal and best2934 both lacked until league issue #45. No code path writes these two keys, and that is the point: arming the marker is a person editing a file. An armed marker with an empty sign-off disarms itself, because `counted: true` with nothing behind it is the shape a copied fixture makes and it is a false declaration under rules 37-38. Absent means friendly.

network._remark: public_url is this role's path behind the shared front door (tools/frontdoor.py). Both roles are served at once from one reserved ngrok domain, so nothing is repointed between sub-games -- required by the odd/even role convention, where the role flips at every sub-game rather than once at half time.
network._public_url_remark: Refreshed 2026-08-16. This had gone FOUR quick-tunnel hostnames stale (toys-christina-velvet-icq, dead/NXDOMAIN) while every liveness check stayed green, because door_watch.sh rewrites poll_league.sh and .door_url and never touched this file. It is not cosmetic: public_url is written into the declaration and network artifacts and offered in the negotiation handshake, so a counted series would have filed a dead endpoint, and a peer that re-resolved us from it would get NXDOMAIN -- rule 6, charging BOTH teams. door_watch.sh now rewrites this key too.

strategy._remark: brain accepts 'package.module:Class' so a strategy can be swapped without touching the engine (guidelines §12.1, extension points).
strategy._barrier_engage_range_remark: Re-derived 1 -> 4 on 2026-08-14 evening by tools/robustness.py, 40 seeds against five structurally different thieves (1200 matches): worst case 0.575 at range 4 versus 0.200 at range 1, mean 0.695 versus 0.385. Selection is max-min, not max-mean, because in a league the opponent is someone else's code -- range 7 has the better mean (0.825) and the worse worst case (0.500). WHY IT MOVED: 1 was measured against a thief that ran to a corner and stopped, so the cop could walk to distance 1 and win. That thief was our own, it was a bug, and the panel now inherits the corner veto -- every member keeps moving. Two agents that both move one cell per turn cannot close distance, so against a thief that runs, barriers are the only way this cop captures at all, and a gate that opens at distance 1 rarely opens. WHAT THE MATCHES SAY, corrected: 42 barriers across 8 cop sub-games against gal-roy1 (5.2/game) and ZERO across 3 against imreeyal. An earlier note here claimed zero against both; that was a miscount -- the sealed record encodes a barrier inside the move string as BARRIER:r,c (protocol.StepIntent.payload via wire_move), not as a separate key, and the count read the key. The real split is by WIRE: zero on reference-v3 (imreeyal), 5.2/game on gal-roy1's alternating dialect, and an in-process reference-v3 dry run reproduces both -- 0 at range 1, 11 at range 4. belief_probe shows the posterior is fine either way, its peak tracking the real thief cell for cell at distance 5. Do not re-pick this from a single-opponent sweep; that curve is chaotic (8, 34, 2, 30, 2, 37, 35 over ranges 1-7 at 40 seeds).
strategy._track_deposit_remark: Fit the thief's exact cell out of the book-model trail and chase it, instead of chasing the belief-weighted expectation. Only has effect under multiplicative_book_v1, whose field accumulates and saturates; the reference model's field already has one unique peak. Measured 2026-08-16 by replaying the real CopBrain against 8 thief trajectories recovered from received wire fields: 0/8 captures off, 8/8 on, median step 17 against a 35-step cap. The replayed thief cannot react to being chased, so that is an upper bound and not a forecast.
strategy._roam_when_blind_remark: Armed 2026-08-16 after the thief was found frozen on one cell for 30 of 35 steps in every networked sub-game against three separate opponents (anrbj666 30/35, gal-roy1 25/35, imreeyal 30/36), always pinned to an edge. Cause: idle_penalty 1.0 against distance_weight 1.2, so on the far wall STAY beat every move by construction. Under pheromone_transmit_lag 1 a stationary thief publishes its LIVE cell rather than a stale one, and the book trail is exactly invertible -- see domain/trail_inversion.py. Offline the flag takes STAY from 30/35 to 0/35, distinct cells 6 to 18, and steps on an edge 33/36 to 9/36. That is a structural claim, NOT a strength claim: unlike the cop change there is no recovered opponent trajectory to replay a thief against, because cops emit no scent. Set false to revert the whole change.

trash_talk._remark: provider: template | ollama | claude_api | claude_cli. 'template' costs zero tokens and is the default, because the book requires the match to be playable with no LLM at all.
